decision: Use new footer versions and a private filter enum with positive fallback
why: Old readers reject new data and construction failures cannot hide keys

decision: Verify every decoded filter against all sorted source keys in release
why: An extra source scan provides a stronger publication check than spot sampling
result: 2M graph members and mixed-format/bit-flip tests pass

decision: Use upstream Clang resource directory and prebuilt RocksDB archive
why: Existing readbench dependency needs system headers; RocksDB is not a measured backend here

decision: Retain the legacy format and keep fuse opt-in while evaluating engine gates
why: Every source member and new block CRC/header are verified; old/new writers can coexist

decision: Freeze separately prepared main and fuse fixtures with identical logical data
why: The filter must be constructed by the real flush and compaction paths
result: All candidate tables use fuse8; zero positive fallbacks

decision: Run all paired cells despite uncontrollable sibling activity and retain every result
why: User reserved CPU 8; other host work prevents a strict idle CPU 9 claim
result: CPU 8 affinity checked for each completed process; promotion requires caution

decision: Consult the fuse filter before a resident point index only when both exist on the same table
why: Fuse negatives are absence proofs (zero false negatives, builder verifies the published filter against all sorted source keys in release); Bloom, positive-fallback and point-less tables keep the original order
result: 11 gates code 0 incl. both 20,000-seed suites (40,000 seeds)

decision: Keep filter-first for fused tables with resident point indexes on this workload mix
why: Resident-index absent-ID misses drop to 0.25-0.27 us on normal/default and 0.066-0.074 us on bulk/default (LMDB-adjusted paired ratios 0.32-0.46); 32 MiB cells unchanged; recent-for-agent unchanged everywhere; point hits within noise at 32 MiB and normal/default, but bulk/default recall-by-id regressed 1.088 -> 1.248 us p50 (paired 1.133, LMDB-adjusted 1.205) - adopted with the tradeoff recorded, not a default recommendation
result: 160 paired processes pinned CPU 8, all success/errors 0; CPU 9 sibling median 9.028 percent so quiet-sibling tails cannot be claimed
